Slice 71 — Stage 6d, the guest's comment control (in progress, not yet packaged)
I ran out of tool calls mid-authoring. What is already written into the tree:

TableOrderSurface.razor — the comment box in §11.1's detail panel beside the like: both comment services injected, ListForPersonAsync for the guest's own standing comments, ReadDeclaredBodyCapAsync driving maxlength so the cap stays the schema's (F-107), Save and Withdraw verbs with the four SubmitMenuItemCommentOutcome sentences, data-comment-outcome beside the sentence so a scenario asserts the verdict rather than the copywriting, and the draft reset on every dish change so a draft on one dish cannot be saved onto another.
app.css — the comment box joins the existing .form-field input/select/textarea selector lists rather than copying their declarations (F-118's ruling), and the panel's pill controls share one rule.
One real finding surfaced while doing it, and it is worth your veto before I finish:

F-127 — §11.12's 16px control floor is enforced over inputs only. The §11.1 barrier's FontFloorSelectors holds two selectors, both input[…]. .order-menu-like has declared font-size: 0.95rem (15.2px) since Slice 58, under a floor the spec says carries no tolerance — and nothing could say so. Same shape as F-118 in the other direction: there the rule could not reach the control, here the barrier could not. The ruling I've taken: the like's declaration goes to 1rem, the comment controls are written at 1rem, and the panel's three controls join FontFloorSelectors so the floor finally has button subjects.

Remaining to author: MenuItemCommentSurfaceContractTests (6 facts), the HandheldReach selectors, TableOrderJourneys comment readers, the scenario-21 comment steps, and spec §7/§11.1/§16.3/§16.4/Appendix A/changelog to v1.56, plus the ledger, plan and build-progress rows. Predicted count: 1327 (1321 + 6).

Slice 71 — Stage 6d. Extract at the repository root; 11 full files, repo-relative paths.

tar xzf myrestaurant-slice-71.tar.gz
git add tests/MyRestaurant.WebApplication.Tests/Menu/MenuItemCommentSurfaceContractTests.cs
One new file, nothing deleted, no new directory. The git add matters — check_tree.sh reads git ls-files.

Expected count: 1327 (1321 + six [Fact]). Scenario 21 is one [Fact] before and after; the harness additions carry no attributes.

What's in it
The guest's comment box in §11.1's detail panel beside the like, over Slice 68's data access. Five rulings in §7: the box is never on the card (a <button> may not hold interactive content); a blank body is a refusal and never a withdrawal; the client's maxlength is whatever the constraint said and every refusal is the server's; the draft belongs to the chosen dish and a MenuChanged broadcast never overwrites it; the outcome is declared beside the sentence so the barrier reads a verdict, not copywriting.

F-127 rides along and is not separable. F-93 made the new controls bring their barrier selectors, which raised the only question that mattered — what type size — and 1rem would have put two sizes in one panel, because .order-menu-like has declared 15.2px since Slice 58 under a 16px floor with no tolerance. FontFloorSelectors held two entries and both were input[type=…]: a button had never been measured for text. The remedy is a selector set, the same shape as F-118's.

Four veto points
data-comment-outcome on the status line (precedent: data-live).
The like's 0.95rem → 1rem — 0.8px on one control.
Scenario 21 rather than a scenario 22 — sixth use of the arrangement already exists.
MenuReactionScenarios.cs keeps its filename; the method is renamed.
Reversion instructions for each are in _CHANGES.md.

Verification
Six facts emulated against the tree and eight planted defects — all reported, including the pre-slice tree. Also emulated green: §16.4's counted-assertion gate (48 paragraphs, none disagreeing), the version gate, seven text-decidable halves of the handheld contract, the harness snapshot rule, and byte hygiene on all ten changed files.

Not verified: nothing compiled, no browser, no container. So 1327 is arithmetic, the six new barrier selectors have never matched anything, and 1rem computes to 16.0px is read off app.css rather than measured. Two Blazor behaviours are read rather than observed — a null int? rendering no attribute, and @key making the box's value follow the dish rather than the element.

Still open: Stage 6e, the staff read — the last row of the plan.
